passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Let go of one thing you're only keeping because of sunk cost

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: The timing will never be perfect. Decide now with what you have.

passages.text: Brainstorm 5 options before choosing between 2

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: After deciding, commit fully for at least one week before reassessing

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Apply ONE thing from the last thing you consumed before consuming more

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take notes, ask questions, teach back — make learning ACTIVE

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.text: Commit to ONE method for 90 days before evaluating

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Measure your progress only against your past self

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Replace 30 minutes of junk info with one deep learning session

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Take ugly rapid notes and spend the saved time practicing

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Explore a topic for 1 hour independently before seeking any expert

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Continue through one plateau — breakthroughs live on the other side

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Start learning RIGHT NOW with whatever you have

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Go deep into ONE topic for a month before exploring another

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Schedule 30 minutes of intentional doing-nothing today
